title: Dissertation
summary: A dissertation project on rugby player profile data that builds a sklearn-style data-augmentation wrapper for class-imbalanced training sets. It fits SDV's TVAESynthesizer on the training features, using conditional sampling and SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic minority-class rows.
